---
title: "Feedback"
toc: false
---

Found an error, a broken link, or something missing from the data? Tell us here.
Submitting opens a pre-filled issue on
[GitHub](https://github.com/vanjaarsveldbarry/globgm_cmip6/issues) in a new tab -
you only need to press *Submit new issue* there. A GitHub account is required.

```{=html}
<form id="fb-form" class="fb-form" novalidate>
  <div class="fb-field">
    <label for="fb-type">What is this about?</label>
    <select id="fb-type" name="type">
      <option value="suggestion">Suggestion or missing content</option>
      <option value="error">Error or bug on the website</option>
      <option value="question">Question</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="fb-field">
    <label for="fb-title">Summary</label>
    <input id="fb-title" name="title" type="text" maxlength="120"
           placeholder="One line, e.g. 'Broken DOI link on the cite page'" required>
  </div>

  <div class="fb-field">
    <label for="fb-body">Details</label>
    <textarea id="fb-body" name="body" rows="6"
              placeholder="What did you expect, what happened instead, or what would you like to see?" required></textarea>
  </div>

  <div class="fb-field">
    <label for="fb-page">Page or file this concerns <span class="fb-optional">optional</span></label>
    <input id="fb-page" name="page" type="text"
           placeholder="URL of the page, or a file name from the Data Catalogue">
  </div>

  <div class="fb-actions">
    <button type="submit" class="fb-submit">Open issue on GitHub</button>
    <span id="fb-status" class="fb-status" role="status"></span>
  </div>
</form>

<script type="module">
  const REPO = "https://github.com/vanjaarsveldbarry/globgm_cmip6";
  const LABELS = {
    suggestion: "enhancement",
    error: "bug",
    question: "question",
  };
  const PREFIX = {
    suggestion: "Suggestion",
    error: "Website error",
    question: "Question",
  };

  const form = document.getElementById("fb-form");
  const status = document.getElementById("fb-status");
  const page = document.getElementById("fb-page");

  if (document.referrer.startsWith(location.origin)) page.value = document.referrer;

  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;

    const type = form.type.value;
    const title = `[${PREFIX[type]}] ${form.title.value.trim()}`;
    const body = [
      form.body.value.trim(),
      "",
      "---",
      `**Page / file:** ${page.value.trim() || "not specified"}`,
      `**Submitted via:** website feedback form`,
    ].join("\n");

    const url = new URL(`${REPO}/issues/new`);
    url.searchParams.set("title", title);
    url.searchParams.set("body", body);
    url.searchParams.set("labels", LABELS[type]);

    const opened = window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener");
    status.innerHTML = opened
      ? "Opened in a new tab. Press <em>Submit new issue</em> there to finish."
      : `Pop-up blocked. <a href="${url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the issue manually</a>.`;
  });
</script>
```

Prefer email? Contact the corresponding author listed in the
[publication](../cite/cite.qmd).
